title: EduThink4AI: Bridging Educational Critical Thinking and Multi-Agent LLM Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the toxicity of text generated from prompts about American actors and actresses (from the BOLD dataset) using a RoBERTa classifier.
Evaluating hurtful sentence completions using the en_queer_unqueer subset of the HONEST dataset.

Probing biases across nine protected categories using the BBQ benchmark, which measures accuracy in disambiguated multiple-choice contexts where models must select between target, non-target, or unknown.

Testing stereotypical associations using the CrowS-Pairs dataset by calculating the percentage of sentence pairs where the model assigns a higher pseudo-log-likelihood to the less stereotypical sentence.
